10378|4fa5b9c3.name: Omusa Thunderhorn
10378|4fa5b9c3.text: Where can I send you today $c?

10378|5d1f9ab4.name: Omusa Thunderhorn
10378|5d1f9ab4.text: Treat the wind rider well as it takes you to your destination.  May your ancestors watch over you $N.

10378|8b4f80e7.name: Omusa Thunderhorn
10378|8b4f80e7.text: Though the Crossroads seems to be the center of activity in The Barrens, I prefer the quietude of Camp Taurajo.  Where shall I send you?

10881|dc8290dc.name: Bluff Runner Windstrider
10881|dc8290dc.text: Greetings and salutations, hero!  I have the latest news from both continents and points beyond for your consideration.

11901|c5ceacbe.name: Andruk
11901|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

12196|7161de72.name: Innkeeper Kaylisk
12196|7161de72.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

12616|c5ceacbe.name: Vhulgra
12616|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

12757|9b4e17a6.name: Karang Amakkar
12757|9b4e17a6.text: Greeting $c - welcome to the front lines in our conquest of Ashenvale!  If you are looking for something to do, then you've come to the right place.  I'm always looking for able-bodied individuals to help bring glory to the Horde!

14728|9cac81e8.name: Rumstag Proudstrider
14728|9cac81e8.text:
Hail brother... I'd like a moment of your time, if I may.

We tauren have endured much in our trials and tribulations in establishing our homeland.  We now find ourselves in a dire shortage of cloth.  If you have the materials to spare, I ask that you please donate them.  You certainly would earn the gratitude of tauren everywhere in helping us out!

2216|8e0e34da.name: Apothecary Lydon
2216|8e0e34da.text: We are but so close to developing the New Plague that our Dark Lady desires with such fervor.

2226|dd7de3ae.name: Karos Razok
2226|dd7de3ae.text: Greetings.  Our bats are well trained and fed.  You'll not find faster.

2391|11012350.name: Serge Hinott
2391|11012350.text: Another student. Wonderful. This is why Lydon belongs to the Royal Society of Snobs and gets to do research, and I'm stuck being an instructor. If I win another teaching award, I'll never live it down!

259118|b3bb7fbb.name: Muln Earthfury
259118|b3bb7fbb.text: I am Muln Earthfury of the Earthen Ring. What brings you before me today?

260093|58279558.name: Garen Largo
260093|58279558.text: Do you require training in the ways of the light?

276171|1e85fa3a.name: Oura Stormspinner
276171|1e85fa3a.text: We shen'dorei have need of additional cloth to replenish our supplies. Any donations you make would be put to good use, and surely raise your esteem with the Windshapers.

2851|c5ceacbe.name: Urda
2851|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

2995|bfaf54b7.name: Tal
2995|bfaf54b7.text: When mounted on the back of a wind rider, one sees that its reputation for strength and speed is well earned.

3310|cc0cf280.name: Doras
3310|cc0cf280.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

3341|bdd68929.name: Gann Stonespire
3341|bdd68929.text:
I walk this road alone, seeking ways to defend my honor and rid this land of our enemies.

What can I do for you, $N?

3368|5a0b913d.name: Borstan
3368|5a0b913d.text: I have the finest meats in Orgrimmar.

3387|da8a5dad.name: Jorn Skyseer
3387|da8a5dad.text: Although we call this land the Barrens, to one who knows where to look this place teems with life.

3429|4e7d06f7.name: Thork
3429|4e7d06f7.text:
Welcome to the Crossroads, $c. My name is Thork--I lead the defenses here in the name of the Warchief.

Please, feel free to make yourself at home. As long as you mind your business, no one should have any problem with you taking up some space.

There are many threats to our safety here. If you've already become familiar with the lay of the land, speak to the others here--perhaps they have tasks for you to do.

3430|71e13f0e.name: Mangletooth
3430|71e13f0e.text:
My hatred is strong <snort>, but the time is right to tell you a tale, $r.

Long ago a battle took place between gods. Agamaggan, our great boar god, fell to the earth after being defeated in the War of the Ancients, his blood raining down and his bones torn asunder. <snort>

Great thorns reached up out of the earth where his blood touched the ground, and his skull adorns one of the caverns to the south.

3433|4ec00f6f.name: Tatternack Steelforge
3433|4ec00f6f.text:
The Warchief has instructed me to study all kinds of weapons and armor. He has sent me here to the hub of both the tauren and orc cultures in the Barrens to meet as many travelers as possible, and to learn about the cultures of the Barrens.

He feels there's something to be learned from even the most pathetic of cultures... like the quilboar or centaur.

3615|ddd7878b.name: Devrak
3615|ddd7878b.text: My wind riders are trained to fly quickly through the hot Barrens air.

3934|e013de07.name: Innkeeper Boorand Plainswind
3934|e013de07.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

4551|d37b59d0.name: Michael Garrett
4551|d37b59d0.text: How may I be of service?

5624|f161af66.name: Undercity Guardian
5624|f161af66.text: Paladins in War Quarter on outer ring. You find them at main building.

6738|41276936.name: Innkeeper Kimlya
6738|41276936.text: Your body looks worn and your spirit weary. Rest yourself beneath our roof and allow Elune to guide your dreams.

6739|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Bates
6739|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

9087|e4fd33dd.name: Bashana Runetotem
9087|e4fd33dd.text: Greetings, noble $c.  This humble servant of the Cenarion Circle wishes blessings and bounties be given unto you and yours.

9566|fc033aae.name: Zapetta
9566|fc033aae.text: My brother said we could make great money with this trade route, but he didn't tell me I would be the one living on this side. If you come back this way on the Zeppelin, could you bring me something to eat? They sell some of the finest meat in Orgrimmar, and I sure could use something that didn't die weeks before it stopped moving.

1008-progress.name: Shindrell Swiftfire
1008-progress.text: We cannot allow the naga to invade our coasts, $N.  It is vital that you go to the Zoram Strand and complete your mission.
1008-progress.title: The Zoram Strand

1034-progress.name: Pelturas Whitemoon
1034-progress.text: Do you yet have the Stardust, $N?
1034-progress.title: The Ruins of Stardust

1153-accept.name: Tatternack Steelforge
1153-accept.text:
$C, you have done well in helping me in the past. The warchief is pleased thus far with what I've accomplished, and asks me to continue with renewed determination. My honor dictates that I give you proper recognition to the warchief for all you have done, but first I would ask you for your help again.

Travelers recently came from the south from a place called Thousand Needles. There they killed a kobold who had an unusual ore sample, but they would not sell it. I want a sample of that ore to examine.
1153-accept.title: A New Ore Sample

1164-accept.name: Genavie Callow
1164-accept.text:
The harlot! The swine! Kenata still lives; her family healthy and prospering while I suffer. Forsaken indeed!

My family is gone, taken by the plague. Our estate also forfeit; looted and burned during the war. And after all that, her and her lousy children had the audacity to steal the only precious belongings I had left.

I don't care about the things they stole any more. What I want now are their heads!

Kill them for me! Go to the Dabyrie Farmstead in Arathi, northeast of Refuge Point.
1164-accept.title: To Steal From Thieves

216-accept.name: Karang Amakkar
216-accept.text:
The Thistlefur furbolgs are threatening our expansion!  Thistlefur Village to our east blocks the way between us here and the Splintertree Post.  It's a path that would circumvent the village of Astranaar; without it, we give the Alliance an extra expansion path.

$N, we must not allow... an expansion path gap!

Proceed to Thistlefur Village and thin out the furbolgs.  You will be given compensation for this task, but more importantly you will be doing your duty for the Horde!
216-accept.title: Between a Rock and a Thistlefur

216-complete.name: Karang Amakkar
216-complete.text:
Well done $c, well done!  I will continue to send forces to thin out the furbolg, but I can at least count on a different path that will be free of Alliance entanglements.  The Horde conquest of Ashenvale is now in full swing!

You've earned your pay this day, hero.  I salute you!
216-complete.title: Between a Rock and a Thistlefur

3513-accept.name: Unknown
3513-accept.text:
The official-looking scroll is wrapped tightly with a silvery ribbon. You're sure someone would be interested in seeing this, but who?

There is an outpost close to the Ashenvale border to the north, and if the information on this scroll involves the night elves, this would be the place to take it.
3513-accept.title: The Runed Scroll

451-progress.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
451-progress.text: What brings you back to the Undercity, $N?
451-progress.title: A Recipe For Death

496-accept.name: Apothecary Lydon
496-accept.text:
Ah, another wretched day in Tarren Mill.  All of this clean air puts me in such a foul mood, $N.

The sooner we can plague the humans here, the better.  I've been conducting intense studies on possible killing agents to use in my concoctions but I haven't the time to collect them all.

If you want to make yourself of use, procure the following items for me:  10 Gray Bear Tongues and the very rare and hard to find, Creeper Ichor.  You'll find both bears and creepers just outside of Tarren Mill.
496-accept.title: Elixir of Suffering

498-accept.name: Krusk
498-accept.text:
Me and some other warriors were sent by the Warchief to retrieve an object from Durnholde and to investigate this so-called Syndicate.

We went to Durnholde to take a look around, but we were taken by surprise by a large number of the humans. We fought bravely, but their sheer numbers were enough to defeat us. They took a few of us captive, but I was able to escape.

Durnholde is just southeast of here, across the river. Drull and Tog'thar are being held there, you must go and rescue them.
498-accept.title: The Rescue

501-accept.name: Apothecary Lydon
501-accept.text:
Oh, $N. . .the flowers are blooming in Hillsbrad and the air is so fresh and brisk.  I can't help but to wallow in the misery of it all.  I look out my grimy window and long for the day when our New Plague brings this world the death it deserves.

As much as I would love to sit and brood all day, my duty to the Dark Lady calls.  Help me, would you?  My research leads me to believe I can make the most splendid death-brew with the blood of a Mountain Lion.  Bring some to me and we'll have a little fun.
501-accept.title: Elixir of Pain

5042-complete.name: Mangletooth
5042-complete.text:
If only Mangletooth were free to see you decimate those who betrayed him! <snort>

I thank you for destroying more of the Bristleback by gathering these shards. Please, continue to do so, and I will continue to aid you. <snort>
5042-complete.title: Agamaggan's Strength

5042-progress.name: Mangletooth
5042-progress.text:
I will need 4 blood shards if you wish Agamaggan's strength, $r.

Your foes will cower before your strength were you to be given this blessing. <snort>

The Razormane's greatest warriors are infused with such power!
5042-progress.title: Agamaggan's Strength

5045-complete.name: Mangletooth
5045-complete.text:
Our greatest warriors, and our greatest <snort> shamans would envy your will, $r.

Defeat more of the Bristlebacks knowing that they cannot stop you! <snort>
5045-complete.title: Rising Spirit

5045-progress.name: Mangletooth
5045-progress.text:
Warriors of all types <snort> have need of a strong spirit. It drives you to greater feats when all hope has been lost. This is not unknown to the <snort> Razormane. We are a spiritual tribe--we are more proud of our connection to Agamaggan than our prowess <snort> in battle.

Bring me 4 blood shards and I will bless your spirit for battle. <snort>
5045-progress.title: Rising Spirit

509-accept.name: Apothecary Lydon
509-accept.text:
Another day, another elixir to be made. If it were up to me, I'd just let the pathetic humans and Scourge fight it out.  They seem bent on killing each other as is.

Alas, our Dark Lady wants to help speed up the process a tad so why not pass these morbid days by spreading a little death and disease across the land?

Here's the plan, $N: you go out to Nethander Stead, south of Tarren Mill and east of the river and Southshore. Collect for me 6 Mudsnout Blossoms from the field for my next elixir.
509-accept.title: Elixir of Agony

527-accept.name: High Executor Darthalia
527-accept.text:
Stand at attention while addressing me, $c.

I am under direct command of Varimathras.  We are to quell the human infestation until our apothecaries can develop the new plague.

Our information leads us to believe that the town of Hillsbrad is vulnerable to attack.  Your first assignment is aimed at disrupting their food supply and infrastructure.

Travel west.  Raid the northernmost farms of Hillsbrad Fields.  Make sure that the landowners, Farmer Ray and Farmer Getz, are executed as well.
527-accept.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

549-accept.name: Unknown
549-accept.text:
By the authority of Lady Sylvanas, all members of the organization known as the Syndicate are wanted dead. Those brought into custody or taken prisoner will be summarily executed. They are currently known to be amassing in the ruins of Durnholde Keep, to the southeast of Tarren Mill.

A handsome reward is offered to all who bring proof of their deeds to High Executor Darthalia.
549-accept.title: WANTED: Syndicate Personnel

567-accept.name: Unknown
567-accept.text:
Dangerous!

The following humans of Hillsbrad have been deemed dangerous and are marked for bounty by High Executor Darthalia:

Clerk Horrace Whitesteed.  Wanted for the murder of Deathguard Toma.

Citizen Wilkes.  Wanted for the murder of Apothecary Eli.

Miner Hackett.  Wanted for the murder of Deathstalker Fry.

Farmer Kalaba.  Wanted for the ambush of supplies from the Undercity.

All of these enemies are hiding and will be hard to find.  A reward will be granted upon notice of their death.
567-accept.title: Dangerous!

6322-progress.name: Michael Garrett
6322-progress.text: If you must travel a long distance, then a bat is your best option.
6322-progress.title: Michael Garrett

6323-progress.name: Gordon Wendham
6323-progress.text: I keep my weapons in top condition.  They are cleaned and ready for use.
6323-progress.title: Ride to the Undercity

6324-progress.name: Deathguard Podrig
6324-progress.text: $N, you return.  Do you have our supplies from the Undercity?
6324-progress.title: Return to Podrig

6442-progress.name: Marukai
6442-progress.text: The naga increase in numbers, $N. Please complete this task for me.
6442-progress.title: Naga at the Zoram Strand

6462-accept.name: Mitsuwa
6462-accept.text:
My kinfolk were traveling here with many sacred troll charms, but the Thistlefur furbolgs attacked and killed them before they reached Zoram'gar!  Those vile Furbolgs!

I miss my brothers and sisters who were killed, but we will meet again in the afterlife.  However, their troll charms hold great value in this world.  It is an outrage that the furbolgs have them!

$N, you must retrieve the charms!  They are in chests in Thistlefur Hold, a cave at the end of Thistlefur Village, north of Astranaar.
6462-accept.title: Troll Charm

6462-complete.name: Mitsuwa
6462-complete.text:
You found them!  Thank you!  Thank you, $N!  You do not know how great a thing you have done for me.

A troll without his charm is like an orc without his battle scars...

Worthless.
6462-complete.title: Troll Charm

6462-progress.name: Mitsuwa
6462-progress.text: Did you find the charms, $N?  Every moment the furbolgs possess those sacred items, my blood boils with rage!
6462-progress.title: Troll Charm

6561-complete.name: Bashana Runetotem
6561-complete.text:
Kelris has eluded the Argent Dawn for some time.

For some time they considered him dead or missing.

By ending his reign you have spared the lives of many innocent people, $N.

Earthmother be praised! To sacrifice another to a servant of an Old God for personal gain is beyond disgusting!

You have done a great thing this day. Kelris was a creature of evil and sought to bring the world back to a time of chaos by worshipping such creatures as the Old Gods. Thank you, $N.
6561-complete.title: Blackfathom Villainy

6561-progress.name: Bashana Runetotem
6561-progress.text:
May the Earthmother be with you, $N.

Peace between the earth and all her people should be our goal. She has a grand plan for nature, and we all have a role to play in that plan.
6561-progress.title: Blackfathom Villainy

6564-progress.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6564-progress.text: Yes, $N? What is it you need? There is still much I must learn about the crystals the naga are gathering.
6564-progress.title: Allegiance to the Old Gods

6621-accept.name: Karang Amakkar
6621-accept.text:
$N, another tribe of Furbolgs,  the Foulweald, live southeast of Astranaar.  They are not as many as the Thistlefur, but their ferocity poses a future threat.  With a show of force, we can remove that threat.

Take this banner, go to the Foulweald village and place it on their totem mound.  They will try to destroy the banner, but hold your ground until their chief, Murgut, appears to save face for the tribe.  Bring me the totem he carries.

Gather your allies, $N.  This is no task for a single $c.
6621-accept.title: King of the Foulweald

6921-progress.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6921-progress.text: Have you been successful in locating the fathom core?  Without it we'll have no idea what the Twilight's Hammer is exactly up to down there.
6921-progress.title: Amongst the Ruins

6922-progress.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6922-progress.text: Ah, hello again $N.  I was just reading the waves the sea, much like I always do.  What brings you to the outpost?
6922-progress.title: Baron Aquanis

741-complete.name: Chief Archaeologist Greywhisker
741-complete.text: Oh my! Leave it to Prospector Remtravel to discover such a find!
741-complete.title: The Absent Minded Prospector

741-progress.name: Chief Archaeologist Greywhisker
741-progress.text: What can I do for you, $r?
741-progress.title: The Absent Minded Prospector

742-accept.name: Bluff Runner Windstrider
742-accept.text:
Attention, young adventurers!  The wilds of Ashenvale await you!

The Horde has established a strong presence in the lands north of the Barrens.  Our two outposts - Splintertree Post and the Zoram Strand Outpost - strive to bring glory to the Horde!  Those who would prove themselves should seek out guidance there.  Of note: Senani Thunderheart in Splintertree Post, directly north of the Barrens, seeks adventurers willing to take part in a great hunt of Ashenvale!
742-accept.title: The Ashenvale Hunt

744-accept.name: Eyahn Eagletalon
744-accept.text:
$N, my brother soon stands before Chief Bloodhoof, and it is my honor to make his headdress for him.

I want to ask a favor of you while I finish tanning these leather straps. There is not time for me to find enough feathers, and I was wondering, would you gather more for me?

You can find feathers of the correct size from the harpies residing far to the north and northwest of Thunder Bluff. I need only 6 azure and 6 bronze feathers to complete the design.
744-accept.title: Preparation for Ceremony

819-accept.name: Unknown
819-accept.text:
A small placard on one of the ends of the keg says,

"Chen Stormstout-

May your spirit be raised and always raise your spirits."
819-accept.title: Chen's Empty Keg

843-accept.name: Busk
843-accept.text:
In solitude I wander these roads.

The dwarves of Bael Modan show no respect for my land. Horrendous blasts drive holes deep into the ground as noisy machines rip apart the hills. Lands which once served as home and provider to my tribe are now riddled with destructive dwarves.

Attempts at reaching a diplomatic resolution have failed. Now is the time for decisive action.

Drive the dwarves from the Bael Modan excavation by force and bring to me the journal of their leader, Prospector Khazgorm.
843-accept.title: Gann's Reclamation

843-complete.name: Gann Stonespire
843-complete.text:
Khazgorm met the fate he earned. I feel no remorse for the fool. He was an infidel on these lands.

May his death serve as a warning to all those who threaten to disrupt our way of life.

Now let me take a moment to study the dwarf's journal....
843-complete.title: Gann's Reclamation

843-progress.name: Gann Stonespire
843-progress.text: Many innocent tauren lost their lives or were forced off their ancestral birthplace when the dwarves of Bael Modan arrived. My land must be reclaimed!
843-progress.title: Gann's Reclamation

846-accept.name: Gann Stonespire
846-accept.text:
It is clear the prospector depended on explosives and those noisy vehicles to rip the ground apart. We can expect a new foreman to take over soon.

I want to give the dwarves a taste of their own medicine. According to these plans if we combine nitroglycerin with wood pulp and sodium nitrate we can create an explosive charge. The rifleman, soldiers and officers in the Keep are known to have the supplies.

Collect these items and bring them to me. I will fashion a charge that the dwarves won't forget!
846-accept.title: Revenge of Gann

846-complete.name: Gann Stonespire
846-complete.text:
I see you are quite industrious, $c.

No doubt we shall soon have a fitting surprise for those dwarves.
846-complete.title: Revenge of Gann

846-progress.name: Gann Stonespire
846-progress.text:
I see you are back, $N.

While Khazgorm's death might delay the digging in my ancestral lands some, it will by no means bring a total end to the destruction.

The Keep at Bael Modan is an increasing military threat. Built to defend the dig site, it is now poised for offensive force as well.

If you have the ingredients I requested, I can fashion a charge that will make the hasty dwarves reconsider their actions here in the Barrens.
846-progress.title: Revenge of Gann

849-accept.name: Gann Stonespire
849-accept.text:
Following Khazgorm's plans it should be no problem to fashion an explosive charge

Ah, there we go.

Now, $N, I am going to entrust you with a special task. Take this explosive stick and use it to blow up the flying machine at Bael Modan.

Not only is the flying machine a key part of the site's infrastructure it also serves as a weapon of war. More importantly it is an icon of power and an insult to the memory of my tribe.

Make me proud by completing this heroic task and you shall be rewarded.
849-accept.title: Revenge of Gann

849-complete.name: Gann Stonespire
849-complete.text: You have done well, $N! May you be revered in Thunder Bluff as a defender of sacred tauren lands and a champion of the lost tribe.
849-complete.title: Revenge of Gann

879-complete.name: Mangletooth
879-complete.text:
It is done then. Better it ends this way, says Mangletooth. <snort> They should have <snort> made sure I was dead when they turned their backs on me instead of leaving <snort> me here in this forsaken cage.

There is but one task left for you to finish, $r.
879-complete.title: Betrayal from Within

879-progress.name: Mangletooth
879-progress.text:
How goes your hunt, $r? <snort>

Thork thinks he knows the truth about who leads the raids against his people, <snort> but he shall learn how wrong he is if you are successful.

My death is inescapable, but you have caused great pain to my enemies, so Mangletooth regrets nothing. <snort>
879-progress.title: Betrayal from Within

885-accept.name: Unknown
885-accept.text: The feather of Washte Pawne is painful to the touch.
885-accept.title: Washte Pawne

885-complete.name: Jorn Skyseer
885-complete.text:
The thunderhawk is a rare beast of the Barrens, and its death can portend great fortune, or great doom.

But Washte Pawne, called "Spirit Biter" in Taurahe, can bring neither... or both.

The pain you felt from hunting Spirit Biter is the pang all feel who make great gains at great costs.  The sting you felt is the pain of regret.

But I can see you have conquered this.  You have learned that regret turns to wisdom, and that through pain one gains strength.

You have learned much, $N.
885-complete.title: Washte Pawne

885-progress.name: Jorn Skyseer
885-progress.text:
There is new resolve within you, $N.  A resolve born from pain...

Are you burdened with the death of Washte Pawne?
885-progress.title: Washte Pawne

889-progress.name: Mangletooth
889-progress.text:
Bring Mangletooth 10 blood shards and I will bless you with great speed. You will run with zhevra and the wind will be jealous of you.

It will not last long, but it should be enough to help you travel throughout the Barrens.
889-progress.title: Spirit of the Wind

893-complete.name: Tatternack Steelforge
893-complete.text:
Excellent, excellent specimens indeed.

The quilboar are further along than I had expected.

Here, $c, take this and get out of my way. I'd better take a closer look at these weapons. We may have underestimated our enemy, and that's the kind of mistake we can't afford to make.
893-complete.title: Weapons of Choice

893-progress.name: Tatternack Steelforge
893-progress.text:
I, too, have doubts that the pathetic quilboars could attain any level of skill in the area of smithing, but I do as the Warchief commands, and I shall learn what I can about the Razormane tribe.

I have had more menial tasks, and I do so willingly if it aids the orc people.
893-progress.title: Weapons of Choice

906-accept.name: Mangletooth
906-accept.text:
Take Lok's head to Thork in the Crossroads, $r. <snort> He should know what has happened to my tribe without any words--ha, not that he would believe Mangletooth helped in <snort> such things. But I am sure he'll reward you for carrying out such a great deed. <snort>

I will continue to bless you with Agamaggan's power for as long as I remain in this cage, $r. Until then, farewell.
906-accept.title: Betrayal from Within

906-complete.name: Thork
906-complete.text:
You found the Razormane leader and killed him yourself, $N? Amazing.

I am without words, but that does not mean I am without thanks. The people of the Crossroads would do well to respect your strength.

I must admit, I thought the leader of these raids on our supply lines was another quilboar. Thank you again, $N.
906-complete.title: Betrayal from Within

942-accept.name: Chief Archaeologist Greywhisker
942-accept.text:
This fossil bears a striking resemblance to one I once saw in Ironforge. An archaeologist by the name of Flagongut brought it to our annual Explorers' League conference. He believed the fossil had a power which could be unlocked somehow.

Last I heard Flagongut had holed up in the Deepwater Tavern in Menethil Harbor, awaiting escort to the Whelgar Excavation Site. Seek him out and show him Remtravel's fossil. Perhaps he can reveal the secrets of the past.

The ship to Menethil departs from Auberdine.
942-accept.title: The Absent Minded Prospector

95140-accept.name: Lumina Windsinger
95140-accept.text:
I see that you have your weapon now, $c. I pray that it will not fail you.

The locals tell me that Old Fire-Eye hunts in a large area south of here and you can generally find him near the gates to Gilneas. Find him, and use your new blade to end him. When it is done, return and you will have the gratitude of the Windshapers.
95140-accept.title: Old Fire-Eye

95140-complete.name: Lumina Windsinger
95140-complete.text:
Thank you, $N. Banon may now rest in peace.

If you would be willing to allow it, I believe that I can impart some magic upon your freshly blooded blade to infuse it with a small measure of the magic of my people.

<Lumina Windsinger's eyes begin to glow a vibrant blue as she touches the bloodstained blade in your hand.>

It is done. It's a small thing, and I could scarcely improve such a magnificent blade. Regardless, I will pray to the winds that it serves you well, $c.
